text.tspan: The pod: a new api replica (1 CPU, 2 GiB) with a PREFERRED pod affinity for the cache pod, and a soft per-zone spread rule

text.tspan: Choice A: make it a hard rule (filtering)

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: required… instead of preferred…: node 1 has no cache pod,
so it is filtered out before scoring and node 2 is the
only candidate. Trade-off: if node 2 is full, the pod waits.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Choice B: raise the plugin weight (your own scheduler)

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: On EKS this needs a second scheduler (schedulerName).
